facts.en: Earned a garment-technology diploma at Fictional Thimblebrook Institute in 2012.
facts.zh: 2012 年在虚构顶针溪学院获得服装技术文凭。

facts.en: Paid pattern assistant at Fictional Foxstitch Apparel from 2012-07 to 2016-10.
facts.zh: 2012-07 至 2016-10 在虚构狐针服装公司任有薪制版助理。

facts.en: Paid pattern cutter at Fictional Willowseam Clothing from 2016-11 to 2021-03.
facts.zh: 2016-11 至 2021-03 在虚构柳缝服装公司任有薪制版师。

facts.en: Paid pattern development lead at the same employer from 2021-04 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-04 至 2026-08 在同一雇主任有薪制版开发负责人。

facts.en: Develops base patterns for woven shirts from approved design drawings and measurement specifications.
facts.zh: 依据获批设计图及尺寸规格开发梭织衬衫基础纸样。

facts.en: Adjusts patterns after fit reviews, recording revision reasons and changed measurement points.
facts.zh: 试穿评审后调整纸样，记录修改原因及变更的测量点。

facts.en: Coordinates the technical work of 3 pattern staff, while their formal performance reviews remain with the technical manager.
facts.zh: 协调 3 名制版员工的技术工作，其正式绩效评审仍由技术经理负责。

facts.en: The design director approves style changes and the technical manager authorizes production patterns.
facts.zh: 设计总监批准款式变更，技术经理批准生产用纸样。

facts.en: Coordinated pattern development for a 2025 spring capsule with 8 shirt styles.
facts.zh: 为 2025 年春季包含 8 款衬衫的小型系列协调制版开发。

facts.en: Personally developed 3 base patterns and checked measurement sheets for the other 5 styles.
facts.zh: 个人开发 3 个基础纸样，并核对其余 5 款的尺寸表。

facts.en: The team’s fit log records 11 review sessions across the 8 styles; some sessions covered more than one style.
facts.zh: 团队试穿日志记录这 8 款共涉及 11 次评审；部分评审覆盖不止一款。

facts.en: The log does not provide a previous-season baseline or a production defect rate.
facts.zh: 该日志未提供上一季基线或生产缺陷率。

facts.en: Uses a CAD pattern system, measurement spreadsheets and versioned pattern libraries.
facts.zh: 使用 CAD 制版系统、尺寸电子表格及带版本记录的纸样库。

facts.en: Explains seam allowances, notch placement and approved revisions to sample-room colleagues.
facts.zh: 向样衣室同事解释缝份、剪口位置及获批修改。

facts.en: Completed an internal introduction to digital grading in 2020-09; later grading output was reviewed by the technical manager.
facts.zh: 2020-09 完成内部数字放码入门培训；后续放码成果由技术经理审核。

facts.en: Volunteers with Fictional Patchfern Sewing Circle, demonstrating hand stitches for simple fabric pouches.
facts.zh: 在虚构拼蕨缝纫社做志愿者，示范用于简单布袋的手缝针法。

facts.en: Designed and sewed a personal reversible apron in 2023 using leftover fabric.
facts.zh: 2023 年使用剩余布料设计并缝制个人双面围裙。

facts.en: Shared the apron at an informal craft gathering; no commercial production run or sales were recorded.
facts.zh: 在非正式手工聚会上分享该围裙；未记录商业批量生产或销售。

facts.en: Enjoys drawing repeating leaf motifs and visiting noncommercial textile displays.
facts.zh: 爱好绘制重复叶片纹样及参观非商业纺织展示。

facts.en: Maintains a weekly list of fit decisions awaiting approval and patterns ready for the next sample round.
facts.zh: 维护每周清单，列明待批准试穿决定及已准备好进入下一轮样衣制作的纸样。
